## Before you post

Search existing requests first. If someone has already suggested this, add a 👍 reaction and a comment with your use case instead of opening a duplicate.

## What would make ISOFORM better?

Tell us what you would like to see.

## Why is this valuable?

Describe the training problem it would solve or the outcome it would improve.

## What would the ideal version feel like?

Keep this short and practical. Screenshots or examples are welcome.

## Voting

Once this is posted, others can vote with a 👍 reaction. We review requests based on demand, safety, and fit with ISOFORM.
